courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 海堤越波模型試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「水下有效重量」與「流速造成阻力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；海堤越波模型試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Submerged effective weight" and "Current-induced drag" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Overtopping model tests for seawalls must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤；海堤越波模型試驗則以以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements; Overtopping model tests for seawalls centres on interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水下有效重量」與「弗勞德縮尺條件」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到海堤越波模型試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「取樣頻帶配置」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Submerged effective weight” and “Froude scaling conditions”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Overtopping model tests for seawalls, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sampling bandwidth selection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤；消波塊製作與安放則以把消波構件的材料品質、形狀與安放接觸連成可追溯驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements; Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement centres on connect concrete armour material quality, geometry and placed contacts through traceable verification, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水下有效重量」與「質量與排水體積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到消波塊製作與安放，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「安放密度與孔隙」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Submerged effective weight” and “Mass and displaced volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Placement density and voids", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 拋石防波堤施工
history.text: 本課的知識脈絡採用可核對的工程文獻，而不替工法編造單一發明年份。美國工兵團官方目錄列出二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊分冊；越波研究團隊於二〇〇七年發布首版手冊，二〇一八年第二版擴展結構型式、試驗與結果解釋。香港海港手冊持續列出勘誤，提醒設計引用必須指定版本。紐比金灣與博斯是海岸防護和監測的比較案例，不表示兩地採用了本課每項構件或假設尺寸。歷史資料用於理解方法演進，合成數據則另作學徒推理練習。
history.textEn: The knowledge history follows verifiable publications rather than inventing a single date when the technique was created. USACE lists its Coastal Engineering Manual parts in2002. The overtopping authors issued the first manual in2007 and expanded structural types, testing and interpretation in the2018 edition. Hong Kong continues to list corrigenda, demonstrating why an applied design must identify its reference version. Newbiggin Bay and Borth are comparisons of coastal protection and monitoring, not claims that both used every component or assumed dimension in this course. Publication history explains methodological development; synthetic values separately support the apprentice exercises.
